def extract_dates(thread):
    emails=thread.get('emails',[])
    bodies=[]
    subjects=[]
    for e in emails:
        subjects.append(e.get('subject','') or '')
        bodies.append(e.get('body','') or '')
    text='\n'.join(subjects+bodies)
    return text

for tid in [47821,47823]:
    th=apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=tid, access_token=gmail_token)
    text=extract_dates(th).lower()
    # look for month/day with yearless patterns
    patterns=[str(sat.day), str(sun.day), sat.strftime('%b').lower(), sun.strftime('%b').lower(), sat.strftime('%Y'), sun.strftime('%Y')]
    hit={}
    for p in patterns:
        hit[p]= (p in text)
    # also show surrounding snippets for 'cairo'
    idx=text.find('cairo')
    snippet=text[idx-100:idx+300] if idx!=-1 else ''
    print('thread', tid, 'label', th.get('label'))
    print('has_cairo', 'cairo' in text)
    print('date_hits', hit)
    print('snippet_around_cairo', snippet[:200].replace('\n',' '))
    print('---')

# Destination path
